items.title: Microsoft 365: Control access to Learning Activities and Teach
items.description: IT administrators can manage access to Learning Activities and Teach from the Microsoft 365 admin center. Configure Learning Activities separately for educators and for students ages 13 and older and enable or disable Teach for educators to align AI experiences with your organization's policies and deployment readiness.

items.title: Microsoft 365: Assign Different Content to Learning Groups in a Single Assignment
items.description:
Enable educators to assign different content (attachments, resources, instructions) to different Individual Groups within a single Assignment. Today teachers must create separate assignments to differentiate — one for advanced readers, another for struggling students, etc. This feature collapses that into one assignment with group-specific content mapping.
Key capabilities:
Map different content to different Individual Groups within one Assignment
Students only see content assigned to their grou

items.title: OneNote: Multimodal capture in Copilot Notebooks (Windows)
items.description: Capture on Windows helps you bring conversations and ideas from meetings, brainstorming sessions, and everyday work into Copilot Notebooks. Capture audio, images, and notes in one experience, then let Copilot turn them into structured notes with key insights, decisions, and action items, in a Copilot Notebook of your choice

items.title: Microsoft Edge: Work Search Banner for Google
items.description: When a user performs a search on google.com from a work profile, Microsoft Edge can detect whether organization-specific results are available for that query. When relevant results are found, a banner is shown with a link to explore those work results with Microsoft 365 Copilot. This builds on the existing experience already available on Bing and extends it to Google, helping users seamlessly access work-related information regardless of their search engine. Admins can control access to this fea

items.title: Microsoft Edge: Security Update Alerts in the Edge management service
items.description: Administrators can choose a severity threshold and receive alerts when a new Edge update includes security fixes that meet or exceed that level, including zero day fixes. This helps organizations quickly identify updates that may require attention, while avoiding unnecessary notifications for routine releases.

items.title: Microsoft Edge: Auto-open Copilot side pane for Outlook links
items.description: When users open links from Outlook, Microsoft Edge can automatically open the Copilot side pane to provide contextual insights and actionable suggestion chips based on email and destination content - such as highlighting key points, and recommending next actions - without disrupting the browsing flow. This experience helps users quickly understand content, take action with fewer steps, and get more value from Copilot while extending productive browsing time in Edge. Admins can control availabili

items.title: Microsoft Edge: Enhanced Autofill
items.description: For desktop users, Microsoft Edge can now autofill additional document types—including passports, driver’s licenses, and other specialized forms—on top of your saved addresses.

items.title: Microsoft Edge: Tracking prevention when browsing InPrivate
items.description: Microsoft Edge is unifying the tracking prevention experience for non-InPrivate and InPrivate browsing windows.  Microsoft Edge will use the same tracking prevention setting as a normal browsing window when in InPrivate mode.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): [Copilot Extensibility] Users in DoD will be able to use custom engine agents
items.description: Users in DoD will be able to use custom engine agents.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): [Copilot Extensibility] Users in GCC-H will be able to use custom engine agents
items.description: Users in GCC-H will be able to use custom engine agents.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): [Copilot Extensibility] Users in GCC-M will able to use custom engine agents
items.description: Users in GCC-M will be able to use custom engine agents.

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Discussion Post Previews
items.description: Discussion post previews allow users to review how their discussion posts will appear before publishing, helping them catch formatting issues, validate content, and post with greater confidence.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Mandatory pre-meeting consent
items.description: We are providing a new configuration experience in Teams Admin Center where tenant admins can enable and customize an explicit consent message before joining any meeting hosted in their organization.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: AI-generated meeting archive for knowledge retention
items.description: Admins can enable a tenant-wide policy that allows Copilot (and Facilitator) to retain key insights from meetings beyond transcript retention periods. This enables Copilot to continue answering questions about past meetings even after transcripts expire. Admins can also configure how long this AI-generated meeting archive is stored.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Run SMB admin tasks faster with Microsoft 365 Admin Agent in Microsoft Teams
items.description: We have decided not to move forward with this change at this time. We apologize for any inconvenience. SMB Admins can use Microsoft 365 Admin Agent in Microsoft Teams to complete common admin tasks and get guidance on critical setup actions.  Admin Agent can add users and assign licenses on behalf of the admin, as well as provide guidance on key SMB related topics such as organisation setup, security settings, and password resets—without leaving the Teams interface.

items.title: OneDrive: Improved max path error experience on desktop
items.description: OneDrive desktop sync users now get clearer, more actionable guidance when file paths exceed the supported 520-character limit. The updated experience shows exactly how many characters a path is over the limit and offers a guided flow to rename or move the affected items so they can sync.

items.title: Outlook: Clear & Flag Actions in New Outlook
items.description: We’re introducing new rule actions in the new Outlook for Web and Windows to give users greater flexibility and control. This includes Clear Categories, Clear Flag, Complete Flag, and Flag Message, enabling more precise automation of message organization and follow‑up workflows. #newoutlookforwindows

items.title: Outlook: Expanded Conditions for Conditional Formatting in the New Outlook for Web and Windows
items.description: The new Outlook for web and Windows now offers expanded Conditional Formatting options, allowing you to highlight emails based on size, read/unread status, presence of attachments, flag settings, categories, or importance. These enhanced rules make it easier to identify critical messages at a glance and visually organize your folders. #newoutlookforwindows
